psychological_meaning: Cactus, with its muted green tone, evokes feelings of resilience, endurance, and adaptability. It represents a quiet strength and the ability to thrive in challenging environments. It can also suggest a sense of natural harmony and grounding, promoting feelings of stability and calm.
